title: Is GTA 6 on sale for Black Friday?
yt_title: Is GTA 6 really on sale this Black Friday? 🏷️ Careful
description: Is GTA 6 really on sale this Black Friday? Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick says there's no plan to discount it over the holidays (GamingBolt). Reportedly, the PlayStation and Xbox stores still charge full price ($79.99 / $99.99), with only small retailer offers. Have you seen an 'official Black Friday deal'? It's fake: the Best Buy offer is reward points, not a lower price. Is it worth full price? Comment below.
rumor_note: Reported (store pages not checked live): no price cut on the PS Store or Xbox Store, only small retailer offers.
